statements.proposition: This change adds handling so that the multiapi option is still accepted but always returns False.
statements.label: FALSE
statements.note: At the PR head, pygen/__init__.py contains no mention of multiapi or any special handling for it. The change only deletes the DEFAULTS entry and the validation. A user-supplied multiapi value stays in _data and is returned as set by __getitem__, and an unset one falls through to _get_default, so nothing forces False. No other changed file adds such handling.
